This role is for a motivated and curious Data Architect / Data Engineer to join the Group Architecture team. This is a hands-on role focused on the development of tools, prototypes, and reference solutions that support enterprise data architecture standards. The successful candidate will work with senior architects and engineers to enable the adoption of best practices across data platforms, pipelines, and domains, helping to ensure scalable, secure, and consistent data delivery across the organization.

Group Architecture is responsible for setting the strategic direction for technology architecture across the enterprise. Your responsibilities include collecting, cleaning, analyzing, and visualizing data, ensuring its accuracy and relevance to provide actionable insights. Your expertise will transform raw data into meaningful information, supporting business goals and maintaining data governance and compliance.

Gathering accurate and complete data from various sources.
(including structured, semi-structured, and real-time data feeds via APIs, cloud storage, and data lakes)

(applying best practices for data quality checks, deduplication, transformation, and enrichment)

Creating visual representations of data to effectively communicate insights.
(via dynamic dashboards using Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI tools)
Generating regular and ad-hoc reports summarizing analysis results.
(automating scheduled delivery pipelines where possible to reduce manual effort)
Writing SQL queries to extract and manipulate data.

Ensuring compliance with data governance policies and regulations.

Using analytical skills to address business challenges with data-driven solutions.
(presenting actionable recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders)

Lead the migration of data pipelines, datasets, KPIs, and dashboards from DOMO to GCP and Looker.

Passion - Loving your work is an absolute must. Each of us in the company is excited about what we do and thereby we think about it all the time. We want you to be the same. That way you wont be working and the work will be something you love to do.
